mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollments (user_id, bootcamp_id, status, enrolled_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bootcampId}, 'ongoing', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, e.user_id AS userId, e.bootcamp_id AS bootcampId, b.name, b.organizer, b.is_kdt AS isKdt, b.started_at AS startedAt, b.ended_at AS endedAt, e.enrolled_at AS enrolledAt, CASE WHEN b.ended_at < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isEnded FROM enrollments e JOIN bootcamps b ON e.bootcamp_id = b.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.enrolled_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM enrollments WHERE id = #{enrollmentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, bootcamp_id AS bootcampId, enrolled_at AS enrolledAt FROM enrollments WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC LIMIT 1
